text:
mia.ops: Vendor just confirmed partial backorder on our H100 allocation — 12/40 units delayed, ETA 3-4 weeks. They offered an air-split for 6 units at extra cost.
raj_infra: Ugh. Which racks/regions are impacted? Need to map to Dedicated pools.
mia.ops: All EU pools impacted: FRA and AMS. US unaffected. Affected instances: redwood-dedicated-eu-prod (6 slots) and redwood-dedicated-eu-burst (6 slots).
julian_hw: If we accept 6 air-shipped units, we can cover the prod pool for two weeks of throughput. How much extra?
supply_vendor_bot: quote #Q-7782: air-split surcharge = $3,400/unit (covers air freight + priority handling). Sea/standard = no surcharge, ETA +3-4 weeks.
sophie_scot: Ouch on price. Is that per-unit landed or per-awb? Any insurance/TSB included?
supply_vendor_bot: surcharge is per unit landed EU inc. basic transit insurance. Customs duties separate.
alex_logistics: Two quick asks: 1) vendor to provide serial numbers for replacements so we can pre-stage depot. 2) if air, confirm AWB and whether courier requires palletization.
mia.ops: Asked vendor for serials and AWB template now. Waiting on their manifest.
raj_infra: On the infra side: recommend we accept 4 air units to bridge prod and leave 2 for burst. We can degrade non-critical batch jobs to compensate for the other 8. Thoughts?
julian_hw: Agree on 4 air. Also request they split RMA so the delayed units are RMA-tracked separately (avoid mixing with shipped ones). We need clear RMA IDs.
sophie_scot: Also check customs HS code for H100 -> vendor might misclassify which causes hold. Add explicit HS: 8542.31 or vendor may use generic.
alex_logistics: Noted HS ask. I'll update customs SOP and notify forwarder. If vendor will reclass, we can expedite clearance.
supply_vendor_bot: vendor update: can do 4 air units. Will issue AWB and RMA IDs by EOD. Pricing updated: invoice addendum pending.
mia.ops: Can the finance team accept addendum? If > $12k extra we need approval. Tagging @raj_infra for cost/impact.
raj_infra: I can cover up to $8k on emergency budget. Above that we escalate to finance. Please get the final quote.
julian_hw: From operations: schedule immediate partial swap once AWB is shared. We'll coordinate depot pre-staging under temp serial placeholders.
sophie_scot: Also ask vendor for return instructions for the DOA units — we want pre-printed RMA labels to avoid depot delays.
alex_logistics: I'll prepare the depot slot booking for next-week arrival window and keep one crossdock buffer.
mia.ops: Vendor just posted AWB draft and RMA list in their portal, link: https://vendor.example/manifest/1719265432 (they included 4 air AWBs).
supply_vendor_bot: AWB sample: ``AWB: 920-11122233; Courier: ExpressAir; Pieces: 4; Weight: 120kg`` RMA IDs: RMA-VE-9921, RMA-VE-9922, RMA-VE-9923, RMA-VE-9924
raj_infra: Good. Proceed with 4 air. alex, please confirm depot booking and clearance docs. julian, sleep-test the canary fallback once 2 units are in prod.
alex_logistics: Booking confirmed. Courier requires commercial invoice with HS 854231. I'll send paperwork to vendor and customs broker.
julian_hw: Will run canary but note reduced concurrency; enable autoscale offload to US pool if latency spikes.
sophie_scot: Keep an eye on duties—if vendor invoices landed value incorrectly we eat the duty. Ask vendor to declare CIF value correctly.
mia.ops: Copying finance and vendor rep. Tagging @supply_vendor_bot to push final invoice.
supply_vendor_bot: Vendor confirms final addendum = $13,600 (4 units * $3,400). Awaiting PO approval.
raj_infra: That's > my emergency limit. Mia please route to finance for approval (urgent). We'll cut provisional PO to avoid ship delay if possible.
mia.ops: On it. Creating provisional PO now and pinging finance.
alex_logistics: Once PO is live, I'll confirm AWB final and depot ETA.
mia.ops: Thanks all. Will update thread when finance responds or vendor pushes invoice. :thumbsup:
